# 2. Load data from REDCap

```{r tokens}

token_names <- c(
  MLW_COMM  = "SAVAC_MLW_COMM_TOKEN_IVI",
```

```{r load-functions}
# Read records from one project ("raw" or "label")
read_redcap <- function(token, site, raw_or_label = "raw") {
  message("> ", site, " [", raw_or_label, "] loading...")
  res <- REDCapR::redcap_read(
    redcap_uri   = uri,
    token        = token,
    raw_or_label = raw_or_label,
    batch_size   = 500,
    verbose      = FALSE
  )
  if (!res$success) {
    warning(site, " [", raw_or_label, "] failed: ", res$outcome_message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  message("  OK: ", nrow(res$data), " rows / ", ncol(res$data), " cols")
  res$data
}

# Read data dictionary from one project
read_metadata <- function(token, site) {
  message("> ", site, " [metadata] loading...")
  res <- REDCapR::redcap_metadata_read(redcap_uri = uri, token = token, verbose = FALSE)
  if (!res$success) {
    warning(site, " [metadata] failed: ", res$outcome_message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  res$data
}
```

## 2.1 Records from a CSV file instead of the API

MRCG community records did not import correctly into REDCap, so MRCG records are
read from the original data file. The data dictionary still comes from the API.

```{r csv-source}
# Records file per site (NA = read records from the REDCap API)
csv_file <- c(
  MLW_COMM  = NA,
  PGI_COMM  = NA,
  MRCG_COMM = "C:/Users/saehyeun.song/Box/Data Science and Innovation (DSI)/Projects/OS/SAVAC/Gambia-MRCG/DM/10_DR/Rawdata/LEO31452SavacCommuni_DATA_2026-08-14_0943(in).csv"
)
csv_encoding <- "UTF-8-BOM"   # use "latin1" if characters look broken

# Slash dates: "mdY" (MM/DD/YYYY) / "dmY" (DD/MM/YYYY), or NA = judge from the file
# MRCG file: all dates are MM/DD/YYYY (e.g. bs_ic_dt 11/20/2025)
csv_slash_order <- "mdY"

# Day / month order of slash dates, judged from values where one part is above 12
# (11/20/2025 can only be MM/DD; 20/11/2025 can only be DD/MM)
slash_evidence <- function(values) {
  v  <- trimws(as.character(values))
  v  <- v[grepl("^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}", v)]
  p1 <- as.integer(sub("^(\\d{1,2})/.*$", "\\1", v))
  p2 <- as.integer(sub("^\\d{1,2}/(\\d{1,2})/.*$", "\\1", v))
  c(n = length(v), mdy = sum(p2 > 12), dmy = sum(p1 > 12))
}
slash_order_of <- function(ev, default) {
  if (ev[["mdy"]] > ev[["dmy"]]) "mdY" else if (ev[["dmy"]] > ev[["mdy"]]) "dmY" else default
}

# Dates in the file may be YYYY-MM-DD (REDCap export) or slash dates in the given order
parse_redcap_date <- function(x, slash_order = "dmY") {
  orders <- c("Ymd", "Ymd HM", "Ymd HMS", slash_order, paste(slash_order, "HM"), paste(slash_order, "HMS"))
  as.Date(parse_date_time(trimws(as.character(x)), orders = orders, quiet = TRUE))
}

# Read a REDCap raw-data CSV and set column types from the data dictionary
read_redcap_csv <- function(path, m, site) {
  message("> ", site, " [raw] reading ", basename(path))
  d <- read.csv(path, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "", check.names = FALSE,
                fileEncoding = csv_encoding)

  base  <- sub("___.*$", "", names(d))
  ftype <- m$field_type[match(base, m$field_name)]
  fval  <- coalesce(m$text_validation_type_or_show_slider_number[match(base, m$field_name)], "")

  # Codes and numbers -> numeric (only when every value is a number)
  is_num <- ftype %in% c("radio", "dropdown", "yesno", "truefalse", "checkbox", "calc", "slider") |
            grepl("^(number|integer)", fval) | names(d) == "redcap_repeat_instance"
  for (i in which(is_num)) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[i]]))
    if (all(is.na(v) == is.na(d[[i]]))) d[[i]] <- v
  }
  # Date / datetime fields -> Date
  date_cols <- which(grepl("^date", fval))
  file_ev   <- slash_evidence(unlist(lapply(d[date_cols], na.omit)))
  file_ord  <- if (!is.na(csv_slash_order)) csv_slash_order else slash_order_of(file_ev, "dmY")
  message("  slash dates: ", file_ev[["n"]], " values; month-first evidence ", file_ev[["mdy"]],
          ", day-first evidence ", file_ev[["dmy"]], " -> read as ",
          ifelse(file_ord == "mdY", "MM/DD/YYYY", "DD/MM/YYYY"))
  if (is.na(csv_slash_order) && file_ev[["n"]] > 0 && file_ev[["mdy"]] == 0 && file_ev[["dmy"]] == 0)
    warning(site, ": day/month order of slash dates cannot be judged from the file; set csv_slash_order")
  for (i in date_cols) {
    raw <- d[[i]]
    ev  <- slash_evidence(na.omit(raw))
    # A column with its own evidence follows it (unless the order is set by hand)
    ord <- if (!is.na(csv_slash_order)) csv_slash_order else slash_order_of(ev, file_ord)
    if (ev[["mdy"]] > 0 && ev[["dmy"]] > 0)
      warning(site, ": ", names(d)[i], " has both MM/DD and DD/MM slash dates - check the file")
    d[[i]] <- parse_redcap_date(raw, ord)
    bad <- !is.na(raw) & is.na(d[[i]])
    if (any(bad)) warning(site, ": ", names(d)[i], " has ", sum(bad), " value(s) not read as a date, e.g. ",
                          paste(head(unique(raw[bad]), 3), collapse = ", "))
  }

  missing_cols <- setdiff(c("record_id", "redcap_event_name", "redcap_repeat_instrument"), names(d))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) warning(site, ": columns not in file: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  not_in_dict <- setdiff(base[!grepl("^redcap_|_complete$", names(d))], m$field_name)
  if (length(not_in_dict) > 0) warning(site, ": ", length(not_in_dict), " columns not in data dictionary, e.g. ",
                                       paste(head(not_in_dict, 5), collapse = ", "))

  message("  OK: ", nrow(d), " rows / ", ncol(d), " cols")
  tibble::as_tibble(d)
}

# Label version of raw data from the data dictionary (choices -> labels)
raw_to_label <- function(d, m) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(m))) {
    f <- m$field_name[i]
    t <- m$field_type[i]
    if (!f %in% names(d) || !t %in% c("radio", "dropdown", "yesno", "truefalse")) next
    ch <- switch(t, yesno = "1, Yes | 0, No", truefalse = "1, True | 0, False",
                 m$select_choices_or_calculations[i])
    parts <- trimws(strsplit(ch, "\\|")[[1]])
    codes <- trimws(sub(",.*$", "", parts))
    labs  <- trimws(sub("^[^,]*,", "", parts))
    d[[f]] <- labs[match(as.character(d[[f]]), codes)]
  }
  for (i in grep("___", names(d))) d[[i]] <- ifelse(d[[i]] %in% 1, "Checked", "Unchecked")
  d
}
```

```{r load-data}
meta <- imap(tokens, read_metadata)   # data dictionaries (API for all sites)

# Records: API, or the CSV file set in csv_file
dat_raw <- imap(tokens, function(tk, s) {
  if (is.na(csv_file[[s]])) read_redcap(tk, s, raw_or_label = "raw")
  else read_redcap_csv(csv_file[[s]], meta[[s]], s)
})
dat_label <- imap(tokens, function(tk, s) {
  if (is.na(csv_file[[s]])) read_redcap(tk, s, raw_or_label = "label")
  else raw_to_label(dat_raw[[s]], meta[[s]])
})

pgi_comm_lab  <- dat_label$PGI_COMM
```

# 4. Functions

```{r functions}
# Build trigger dataset with baseline (bs_) variables and age
# baseline_event / trigger_event: event names differ by site
# bs_fields: baseline variables to attach (NULL = all bs_ variables)
make_comm_trigger <- function(df,
                              baseline_event = "baseline_arm_1",
                              trigger_event  = "trigger_arm_1",
                              bs_fields      = NULL) {

  # Baseline: non-repeating row only (one row per record), baseline variables only
  bs_cols <- if (is.null(bs_fields)) grep("^bs_", names(df), value = TRUE) else
    names(df)[sub("___.*$", "", names(df)) %in% bs_fields]
  bs <- df %>%
    filter(redcap_event_name == baseline_event,
           is.na(redcap_repeat_instrument)) %>%
    select(record_id, all_of(bs_cols))

  # Add age-related variables missing in some sites (filled with NA)
  for (v in c("bs_dob", "bs_ic_dt", "bs_age_year", "bs_age_month", "bs_age_calc", "bs_est_dob_yrs")) {
    if (!v %in% names(bs)) bs[[v]] <- NA
  }

  # DOB usable: if bs_dob_known exists (MRCG), only when bs_dob_known == 1
  bs$dob_ok <- if ("bs_dob_known" %in% names(bs)) bs$bs_dob_known %in% 1 else TRUE

  bs <- bs %>%
    mutate(
      # as.character() first so all-NA logical columns convert safely
      bs_dob   = as.Date(as.character(bs_dob)),
      bs_ic_dt = as.Date(as.character(bs_ic_dt)),

      # Age at informed consent from DOB
      age_dob = if_else(dob_ok,
                        time_length(interval(bs_dob, bs_ic_dt), "year"),
                        NA_real_),

      # REDCap-calculated age
      age_calc = as.numeric(bs_age_calc),

      # Reported age (years + months; months only for under 1 year)
      age_reported = case_when(
        !is.na(bs_age_year)  ~ as.numeric(bs_age_year) + coalesce(as.numeric(bs_age_month), 0) / 12,
        !is.na(bs_age_month) ~ as.numeric(bs_age_month) / 12,
        TRUE                 ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # Estimated age in years when DOB is not known (MRCG: bs_dob_known = 99)
      age_estimated = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bs_est_dob_yrs)),

      # Final age: DOB first, then REDCap-calculated age, then reported, then estimated
      age_exact  = coalesce(age_dob, age_calc, age_reported, age_estimated),
      age_years  = round(age_exact, 1),
      age_source = case_when(
        !is.na(age_dob)       ~ "dob",
        !is.na(age_calc)      ~ "calc",
        !is.na(age_reported)  ~ "reported",
        !is.na(age_estimated) ~ "estimated",
        TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-dob_ok)

  # Trigger: drop empty bs_ columns, then attach baseline info
  df %>%
    filter(redcap_event_name == trigger_event) %>%
    select(-starts_with("bs_")) %>%
    select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x)))) %>%          # drop columns empty in trigger rows
    mutate(record_id = as.character(record_id)) %>%
    left_join(bs %>% mutate(record_id = as.character(record_id)),
              by = "record_id", relationship = "many-to-one")
}

# Age group: completed years (floor) from unrounded age, so 18.9 stays in 15-18
add_age_group <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      age_int   = floor(age_exact),
      age_group = case_when(
        age_int <  5                 ~ "<5",
        age_int >= 5  & age_int < 15 ~ "5-14",
        age_int >= 15 & age_int < 19 ~ "15-18",
        age_int >= 19                ~ "19+",
        TRUE                         ~ "Missing"
      ),
      age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("<5", "5-14", "15-18", "19+", "Missing"))
    )
}

# Age group counts for one site (unique records, n + %)
age_table <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    distinct(record_id, age_group) %>%
    count(age_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(age_group = "Total", n = sum(.$n), pct = 100))
}
```

# 5. Build trigger datasets

```{r build}
# Attach only the baseline individual form (all bs_ variables if the form is not found)
baseline_form <- "baseline_visit_individual"
bs_fields_of  <- function(m) {
  f <- m$field_name[m$form_name == baseline_form]
  if (length(f) == 0) {
    warning("Form '", baseline_form, "' not found: attaching all bs_ variables")
    return(NULL)
  }
  f
}

mlw_comm_trig  <- make_comm_trigger(mlw_comm_raw, bs_fields = bs_fields_of(meta$MLW_COMM)) %>%
  add_age_group()

pgi_comm_trig  <- make_comm_trigger(pgi_comm_raw, bs_fields = bs_fields_of(meta$PGI_COMM)) %>%
  add_age_group()

mrcg_comm_trig <- make_comm_trigger(mrcg_comm_raw,
                                    baseline_event = "baseline_q0_arm_1",
                                    bs_fields      = bs_fields_of(meta$MRCG_COMM)) %>%
  add_age_group()
```

# 8. All variables - summary by site

Trigger form variables (`tr_`) of the community trigger datasets (section 5:
trigger event rows with the baseline individual form attached) are summarised by
variable type and compared side by side across sites, the same way as the
Hospital report, counted per trigger row. Set `var_prefix` to `"."` to include
the attached baseline variables as well (those are counted once per record). Questions and answers
come from each site's data dictionary; branching logic sets each denominator.
Sites are matched by variable name (no varmap): variables named differently at a
site show as "Not in form" and are listed under data dictionary differences.

## 8.1 Settings

```{r cmp-settings}
site_labels <- c(MLW_COMM = "MLW", PGI_COMM = "PGI", MRCG_COMM = "MRCG")

# Variables to compare (regex on field_name): trigger form only
var_prefix <- "^tr_"

# System / helper fields to exclude
exclude_pattern <- "^record_id$|_warn|_entdt_server|_entdt_now|_entdt_utc|_entby_web|_entby_app"

# Completeness below this % is highlighted in the overview
low_threshold <- 90

# Baseline variables repeat on every trigger row of a record: count them once per record
record_level <- "^bs_"

# Analysis rows per site = trigger datasets
cmp_data <- list(MLW_COMM = mlw_comm_trig, PGI_COMM = pgi_comm_trig, MRCG_COMM = mrcg_comm_trig)
```

## 8.2 Functions

```{r cmp-functions}
strip_html <- function(x) trimws(gsub("<.*?>", "", x))

# Data dictionary of selected variables with variable type
classify_fields <- function(m) {
  m %>%
    filter(grepl(var_prefix, field_name),
           field_type != "descriptive",
           !grepl(exclude_pattern, field_name)) %>%
    mutate(
      field_label = strip_html(field_label),
      validation  = coalesce(text_validation_type_or_show_slider_number, ""),
      var_type = case_when(
        field_type %in% c("radio", "dropdown", "yesno", "truefalse")  ~ "Cate",
        field_type == "checkbox"                                      ~ "Check",
        field_type == "calc"                                          ~ "Calc",
        field_type == "slider"                                        ~ "Cont",
        field_type == "text" & grepl("^date", validation)             ~ "Date",
        field_type == "text" & grepl("^time", validation)             ~ "Time",
        field_type == "text" & grepl("^(number|integer)", validation) ~ "Cont",
        TRUE                                                          ~ "Text"
      ),
      choices = case_when(
        field_type == "yesno"     ~ "1, Yes | 0, No",
        field_type == "truefalse" ~ "1, True | 0, False",
        TRUE                      ~ select_choices_or_calculations
      )
    )
}

# "1, Yes | 0, No" -> code / label table
parse_choices <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || s == "") return(tibble(code = character(), label = character()))
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(s, "\\|")[[1]])
  tibble(code  = trimws(sub(",.*$", "", parts)),
         label = strip_html(sub("^[^,]*,", "", parts)))
}

# REDCap branching logic -> R expression
logic_to_r <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") return(NA_character_)
  x <- gsub("\n", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[event-name\\]", "[redcap_event_name]", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[[^]]*_arm_[^]]*\\]", "", x)                            # drop [event_arm_1] prefix
  x <- gsub("\\]\\[current-instance\\]", "]", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\(([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\\)\\]", "[\\1___\\2]", x)     # checkbox [var(1)]
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\]\\s*<>\\s*(''|\"\")", "!is.na(\\1)", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\]\\s*=\\s*(''|\"\")", "is.na(\\1)", x)
  x <- gsub("\\[(\\w+)\\]", "\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("<>", "!=", x)
  x <- gsub("(?<![<>!=])=(?!=)", "==", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\band\\b", "&", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\bor\\b", "|", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x
}

# Keep rows meeting branching logic; if logic cannot be evaluated, keep all rows
apply_logic <- function(dat, logic) {
  cond <- logic_to_r(logic)
  if (is.na(cond)) return(list(dat = dat, applied = NA))
  keep <- tryCatch(eval(parse(text = cond), envir = dat), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(keep) && length(keep) == 1) keep <- rep(keep, nrow(dat))
  if (is.null(keep) || length(keep) != nrow(dat)) return(list(dat = dat, applied = FALSE))
  list(dat = dat[keep %in% TRUE, , drop = FALSE], applied = TRUE)
}

# Rows of target records (in the given event) where any selected variable has a response
get_form_rows <- function(df, dict, ids, event = NA) {
  df <- df %>% filter(record_id %in% ids)
  if (!is.na(event)) df <- df %>% filter(redcap_event_name == event)
  check_fields <- dict$field_name[dict$var_type == "Check"]
  other_fields <- dict$field_name[!dict$var_type %in% c("Check", "Calc")]
  cols <- names(df)[names(df) %in% other_fields |
                    sub("___.*$", "", names(df)) %in% check_fields]
  if (length(cols) == 0 || nrow(df) == 0) return(df[0, ])
  answered <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(cols, function(cl) {
    if (grepl("___", cl)) df[[cl]] %in% c(1, "1")
    else !is.na(df[[cl]]) & trimws(as.character(df[[cl]])) != ""
  }))
  df[answered, , drop = FALSE]
}

fmt_n_pct <- function(k, d) {
  if (d == 0) return(as.character(k))
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", as.integer(k), k / d * 100)
}
fmt_num <- function(v, digits = 1) formatC(v, format = "f", digits = digits)

# Summary of one variable for one site
# d:  this site's dictionary row; mc: master choices of the field (code, label, ord)
# tab: rows (row, value, ord); ord 900 = Missing / None checked, 999 = Total
# k: number answered, n: denominator after branching logic
# Choices not offered at this site are shown as "-"
summarise_var <- function(dat, d, mc) {
  lg  <- apply_logic(dat, d$branching_logic)
  dat <- lg$dat
  n   <- nrow(dat)
  f   <- d$field_name
  site_codes <- parse_choices(d$choices)$code

  if (d$var_type != "Check" && !f %in% names(dat)) {
    tab <- tibble(row = "Not exported", value = "-", ord = 1)
    k   <- NA_integer_
  } else if (d$var_type == "Cate") {
    x   <- as.character(dat[[f]])
    cnt <- vapply(mc$code, function(cd) sum(x %in% cd), integer(1))
    val <- ifelse(mc$code %in% site_codes, fmt_n_pct(cnt, n), "-")
    # Values not in the dictionary, shown as raw code
    unk     <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(x)), mc$code)
    unk_lab <- if (length(unk) > 0) paste0("[code ", unk, "]") else character(0)
    unk_val <- if (length(unk) > 0) fmt_n_pct(vapply(unk, function(cd) sum(x %in% cd), integer(1)), n) else character(0)
    k   <- sum(!is.na(x))
    tab <- tibble(row   = c(mc$label, unk_lab, "Missing"),
                  value = c(val, unk_val, fmt_n_pct(n - k, n)),
                  ord   = c(mc$ord, 800 + seq_along(unk), 900))
  } else if (d$var_type == "Check") {
    cols <- paste0(f, "___", tolower(gsub("-", "_", mc$code)))
    hit  <- lapply(cols, function(cl) if (cl %in% names(dat)) dat[[cl]] %in% c(1, "1") else NULL)
    has  <- !vapply(hit, is.null, logical(1))
    cnt  <- vapply(hit, function(h) if (is.null(h)) 0L else sum(h), integer(1))
    none <- if (any(has)) sum(Reduce(`+`, hit[has]) == 0) else n
    k    <- n - none
    tab <- tibble(row   = c(mc$label, "None checked"),
                  value = c(ifelse(has, fmt_n_pct(cnt, n), "-"), fmt_n_pct(none, n)),
                  ord   = c(mc$ord, 900))
  } else if (d$var_type %in% c("Cont", "Calc")) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dat[[f]])))
    k <- sum(!is.na(v))
    tab <- tibble(
      row   = c("N", "Missing", "Mean (SD)", "Median", "Min, Max"),
      value = c(as.character(k),
                fmt_n_pct(n - k, n),
                if (k > 0) paste0(fmt_num(mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)), " (", fmt_num(sd(v, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ")") else "-",
                if (k > 0) fmt_num(median(v, na.rm = TRUE)) else "-",
                if (k > 0) paste0(fmt_num(min(v, na.rm = TRUE)), ", ", fmt_num(max(v, na.rm = TRUE))) else "-"),
      ord   = c(1, 900, 2, 3, 4)
    )
  } else if (d$var_type %in% c("Date", "Time")) {
    v <- as.character(dat[[f]])
    v <- v[!is.na(v) & v != ""]
    k <- length(v)
    tab <- tibble(row   = c("N", "Missing", "Min", "Max"),
                  value = c(as.character(k), fmt_n_pct(n - k, n),
                            if (k > 0) min(v) else "-", if (k > 0) max(v) else "-"),
                  ord   = c(1, 900, 2, 3))
  } else {
    v <- as.character(dat[[f]])
    answered <- !is.na(v) & trimws(v) != ""
    k <- sum(answered)
    tab <- tibble(row   = c("N", "Missing", "Unique values"),
                  value = c(as.character(k), fmt_n_pct(n - k, n),
                            as.character(length(unique(v[answered])))),
                  ord   = c(1, 900, 2))
  }

  tab <- bind_rows(tab, tibble(row = "Total", value = as.character(n), ord = 999))
  list(tab = tab, applied = lg$applied, k = as.integer(k), n = n)
}

# Detail comparison flextable for one variable (question label in header)
make_compare_ft <- function(tab, header_n, question) {
  ft <- flextable(tab)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = c(list(row = question), as.list(header_n)))
  ft <- bold(ft, i = ~ row == "Total")
  ft <- color(ft, i = ~ row %in% c("Missing", "None checked"), j = 1, color = "#C00000")
  ft <- bold(ft, i = ~ row %in% c("Missing", "None checked"), j = 1)
  if (nrow(tab) > 1) ft <- hline(ft, i = nrow(tab) - 1, border = fp_border(width = 2))
  ft <- align(ft, j = 2:ncol(tab), align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- width(ft, j = 1, width = 2.8)
  ft <- width(ft, j = 2:ncol(tab), width = 1.3)
  ft
}
```

## 8.3 Analysis rows per site

```{r cmp-build}
# Dictionary per site: variables present in that site's trigger dataset
trig_dict <- imap(cmp_data, function(df, s) {
  classify_fields(meta[[s]]) %>%
    filter(field_name %in% unique(sub("___.*$", "", names(df))))
})
trig_rows <- cmp_data

# Rows used for one variable: one row per record for baseline variables, all trigger rows otherwise
rows_for <- function(field, s) {
  if (grepl(record_level, field)) distinct(trig_rows[[s]], record_id, .keep_all = TRUE) else trig_rows[[s]]
}

# Site overview
trig_overview <- tibble(
  site         = unname(site_labels[names(trig_dict)]),
  forms        = map_chr(trig_dict, ~ paste(unique(.x$form_name), collapse = ", ")),
  n_fields     = map_int(trig_dict, nrow),
  form_rows    = map_int(trig_rows, nrow),
  form_records = map_int(trig_rows, ~ n_distinct(.x$record_id))
)
trig_overview

# Header labels with number of rows per site
header_n <- setNames(paste0(site_labels, "\n(n=", map_int(trig_rows, nrow)[names(site_labels)], ")"),
                     site_labels)
```

## 8.4 Combined data dictionary

One row per variable across all sites. Question, type, choices and branching
logic come from the first site where the variable appears (MLW > PGI > MRCG);
differences between sites are flagged in `issues`.

```{r cmp-dictionary}
# Stop early if no variable matches var_prefix
if (sum(map_int(trig_dict, nrow)) == 0) {
  stop("No variables match var_prefix = '", var_prefix, "'. ",
       "Check names with: map(meta, ~ grep(var_prefix, .x$field_name, value = TRUE))")
}

# All sites' dictionaries stacked (pos = order of first appearance)
dict_all <- bind_rows(trig_dict, .id = "site_key") %>%
  mutate(site = unname(site_labels[site_key]),
         pos  = row_number())

# Master dictionary: one row per variable
master_dict <- dict_all %>%
  group_by(field_name) %>%
  summarise(
    # Difference flags first (before the columns are collapsed to one value)
    diff_type       = n_distinct(var_type) > 1,
    diff_label      = n_distinct(field_label) > 1,
    diff_choices    = n_distinct(coalesce(choices, "")) > 1,
    diff_logic      = n_distinct(coalesce(branching_logic, "")) > 1,
    sites           = paste(site, collapse = ", "),
    pos             = min(pos),
    form_name       = first(form_name),
    var_type        = first(var_type),
    field_label     = first(field_label),
    choices         = first(choices),
    branching_logic = first(branching_logic),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(pos) %>%
  select(-pos)

# Question label per site (side by side)
label_by_site <- dict_all %>%
  select(field_name, site, field_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = field_label, names_prefix = "label_")

# Text summary of differences for one variable
make_issues <- function(sites, diff_type, diff_label, diff_choices, diff_logic) {
  not_in <- setdiff(site_labels, strsplit(sites, ", ")[[1]])
  paste(c(
    if (length(not_in) > 0) paste0("Not in ", paste(not_in, collapse = ", ")),
    if (diff_type)    "Type differs",
    if (diff_label)   "Question differs",
    if (diff_choices) "Choices differ",
    if (diff_logic)   "Branching logic differs"
  ), collapse = "; ")
}

master_dict <- master_dict %>%
  left_join(label_by_site, by = "field_name")
master_dict$issues <- pmap_chr(
  master_dict[c("sites", "diff_type", "diff_label", "diff_choices", "diff_logic")],
  make_issues
)

master_dict

# Master choices: union of codes across sites (order: first site, then new codes)
cate_dict <- dict_all %>% filter(var_type %in% c("Cate", "Check"))

choices_all <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(cate_dict)), function(i) {
  parse_choices(cate_dict$choices[i]) %>%
    mutate(field_name = cate_dict$field_name[i],
           site       = cate_dict$site[i],
           .before = 1)
})
# Keep expected columns even when there are no categorical variables
if (nrow(choices_all) == 0) {
  choices_all <- tibble(field_name = character(), site = character(),
                        code = character(), label = character())
}

master_choices <- choices_all %>%
  distinct(field_name, code, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(field_name) %>%
  mutate(ord = row_number(),
         # Row labels must be unique within a variable and not clash with summary rows
         label = ifelse(duplicated(label) | duplicated(label, fromLast = TRUE) |
                          label %in% c("", "Missing", "None checked", "Total"),
                        paste0(label, " [", code, "]"), label)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(field_name, code, label, ord)

# Answer label per site (side by side) for checking
choices_by_site <- master_choices %>%
  left_join(choices_all %>%
              select(field_name, code, site, site_label = label) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = site_label, names_prefix = "label_"),
            by = c("field_name", "code"))

choices_by_site

# Variables with differences between sites
dict_issues <- master_dict %>%
  filter(issues != "") %>%
  select(field_name, field_label, sites, issues)
dict_issues
```

## 8.5 Site values by master dictionary

```{r cmp-values}

trig_compare <- map(seq_len(nrow(master_dict)), function(i) {
  fld <- master_dict$field_name[i]
  mc  <- master_choices %>% filter(field_name == fld) %>% select(code, label, ord)

  # Summary per site (NULL if the field is not in that site's dictionary)
  res <- imap(trig_dict, function(d, s) {
    dd <- d %>% filter(field_name == fld)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(NULL)
    summarise_var(rows_for(fld, s), dd[1, ], mc)
  })

  # Detail table
  long <- imap_dfr(compact(res), ~ .x$tab %>%
                     mutate(site = site_labels[[.y]], logic_applied = .x$applied))
  wide <- long %>%
    group_by(row) %>% mutate(ord = min(ord)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    select(row, ord, site, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = value, values_fill = "-",
                values_fn = ~ paste(.x, collapse = " / ")) %>%
    arrange(ord) %>%
    select(-ord)
  for (s in site_labels) if (!s %in% names(wide)) wide[[s]] <- "Not in form"
  wide <- wide %>% select(row, all_of(unname(site_labels)))

  # Completeness per site
  comp <- imap_dfr(res, function(r, s) {
    if (is.null(r)) return(tibble(site = site_labels[[s]], k = NA_integer_, n = NA_integer_,
                                  pct = NA_real_, cell = "Not in form"))
    if (is.na(r$k)) return(tibble(site = site_labels[[s]], k = NA_integer_, n = r$n,
                                  pct = NA_real_, cell = "Not exported"))
    pct <- if (r$n > 0) r$k / r$n * 100 else NA_real_
    tibble(site = site_labels[[s]], k = r$k, n = r$n, pct = pct,
           cell = if (r$n > 0) sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", r$k, r$n, pct) else "0/0")
  })

  list(
    field      = fld,
    label      = master_dict$field_label[i],
    type       = master_dict$var_type[i],
    logic      = master_dict$branching_logic[i],
    issues     = master_dict$issues[i],
    logic_fail = unique(long$site[long$logic_applied %in% FALSE]),
    table      = wide,
    comp       = comp
  )
})

# Completeness overview (one row per variable)
trig_completeness <- map_dfr(trig_compare, ~ .x$comp %>%
                               mutate(field = .x$field, label = .x$label, type = .x$type, .before = 1))

completeness_wide <- trig_completeness %>%
  select(field, label, type, site, cell, pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = c(cell, pct))

overview_cells <- completeness_wide %>%
  select(field, label, type, all_of(paste0("cell_", site_labels))) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^cell_", "", .x))
overview_pct <- completeness_wide %>%
  select(all_of(paste0("pct_", site_labels))) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^pct_", "", .x))

overview_cells

# Long table of all detail rows (for checking / Excel)
trig_compare_long <- map_dfr(trig_compare, ~ .x$table %>%
                               rename(response = row) %>%
                               mutate(field = .x$field, question = .x$label, type = .x$type, .before = 1))
trig_compare_long
```

# 9. Word report

One Word file: age group summary and ID lists first, then the variable comparison.

## 9.1 Age group summary

```{r word-age}
doc <- if (file.exists("DocStyle.docx")) read_docx("DocStyle.docx") else read_docx()

fmt_date <- function(x) coalesce(format(x, "%d %b %Y"), "-")

# Summary flextable: bold Total row with a line above it
make_summary_ft <- function(df, labels = list()) {
  ft <- flextable(df)
  if (length(labels) > 0) ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = labels)
  tot <- which(df[[1]] == "Total")
  if (length(tot) > 0) {
    ft <- bold(ft, i = tot)
    if (tot > 1) ft <- hline(ft, i = tot - 1, border = fp_border(width = 2))
  }
  ft <- align(ft, j = 2:ncol(df), align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 9, part = "all")
  autofit(ft)
}

doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Community - trigger records by age group", style = "heading 1")
doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("Trigger records (unique record ID). Created ", format(Sys.Date(), "%d %b %Y"), "."))

doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Number of records by age group", style = "heading 2")
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_summary_ft(age_summary_pct %>% mutate(site = as.character(site)),
                                               list(site = "Site")))
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Age in completed years at consent (bs_ic_dt); % of site total.")

# ID list per site
doc <- body_add_break(doc)
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Record ID list by age group", style = "heading 2")
for (nm in names(age_ids)) {
  ids <- age_ids[[nm]] %>%
    mutate(age_years = round(age_years, 1), across(c(bs_dob, bs_ic_dt), fmt_date))
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0(sub("^ids_", "", nm), " (N = ", nrow(ids), ")"), style = "heading 3")
  if (nrow(ids) == 0) {
    doc <- body_add_par(doc, "No records.")
    next
  }
  ft <- flextable(ids)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, record_id = "Record ID", age_group = "Age group", age_years = "Age (years)",
                          age_source = "Age source", bs_dob = "Date of birth", bs_ic_dt = "Consent date")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 2:ncol(ids), align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 8, part = "all")
  ft <- autofit(ft)
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")
}
doc <- body_add_break(doc)
```

## 9.2 Variables summary by site

```{r cmp-word}
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Community - variables summary by site", style = "heading 1")
doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("Trigger records with baseline (bs_) variables. Created ", format(Sys.Date(), "%d %b %Y"), "."))

# Site overview
ft_site <- flextable(trig_overview)
ft_site <- set_header_labels(ft_site, site = "Site", forms = "Form(s)", n_fields = "Variables",
                             form_rows = "Trigger rows", form_records = "Records")

                 align = "center", part = "all")

# Dictionary differences between sites
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Data dictionary differences", style = "heading 2")
if (nrow(dict_issues) > 0) {
  ft_iss <- flextable(dict_issues)
  ft_iss <- set_header_labels(ft_iss, field_name = "Variable", field_label = "Question",
                              sites = "Sites", issues = "Differences")
  ft_iss <- fontsize(ft_iss, size = 8, part = "all")
  ft_iss <- width(ft_iss, j = "field_name",  width = 1.2)
  ft_iss <- width(ft_iss, j = "field_label", width = 2.4)
  ft_iss <- width(ft_iss, j = "sites",       width = 1.0)
  ft_iss <- width(ft_iss, j = "issues",      width = 2.0)
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_iss)
} else {
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, "All selected variables have the same definition across sites.")
}
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")

# Completeness overview
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Completeness overview", style = "heading 2")
doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("Answered / denominator (after branching logic). Red: below ",
                                low_threshold, "%. Grey: not in form or not exported."))

ft_comp <- flextable(overview_cells)
ft_comp <- set_header_labels(ft_comp, field = "Variable", label = "Question", type = "Type")
for (s in site_labels) {
  low <- which(!is.na(overview_pct[[s]]) & overview_pct[[s]] < low_threshold)
  na  <- which(overview_cells[[s]] %in% c("Not in form", "Not exported"))
  if (length(low) > 0) ft_comp <- bg(ft_comp, i = low, j = s, bg = "#F8D7DA")
  if (length(na)  > 0) ft_comp <- bg(ft_comp, i = na,  j = s, bg = "#E7E6E6")
}
ft_comp <- align(ft_comp, j = c("type", site_labels), align = "center", part = "all")
ft_comp <- fontsize(ft_comp, size = 8, part = "all")
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = "field", width = 1.2)
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = "label", width = 2.4)
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = "type",  width = 0.5)
ft_comp <- width(ft_comp, j = site_labels, width = 1.0)
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_comp)
doc <- body_add_break(doc)

# Detail tables
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Detail by variable", style = "heading 2")
for (item in trig_compare) {
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, item$label, style = "heading 3")

  info <- paste0("Variable: ", item$field, " | Type: ", item$type)
  if (!is.na(item$logic) && item$logic != "") info <- paste0(info, " | Branching logic: ", gsub("\n", " ", item$logic))
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, info)
  if (item$issues != "") doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("* Dictionary differences: ", item$issues))
  if (length(item$logic_fail) > 0) {
    doc <- body_add_par(doc, paste0("* Branching logic not applied (all rows used): ",
                                    paste(item$logic_fail, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, make_compare_ft(item$table, header_n, item$label))
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, "")
}

out_docx <- paste0("SAVAC_COMM_report_", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), ".docx")
print(doc, target = out_docx)
out_docx
```
